root.name: move-and-verify
root.description: Move a loaded joint device to a target and verify fresh, quiet measured arrival.
root.Instructions: Call move_and_verify with device, world, joints, joint_tolerance and quiet_velocity. Bind device and world to loaded devices. Targets and tolerances follow model joint order: radians and radians/second for rotary joints, metres and metres/second for prismatic joints. Supply tolerances explicitly; scalars apply to every joint. Success requires fresh measured arrival for stable_s (default 0.1). timeout_s uses world time (default 10); the host separately caps execution at 120 wall seconds. Calls run cooperatively between ticks. There is no parallel I/O or automatic motion retry. Cancellation stops only motion still owned by this invocation. Existing Python environments need py-trees==2.6.0; use uv add --project <python.project> 'py-trees==2.6.0'.
